bug_semantics: CWE-639 IDOR plus missing auth on product update/save: Product::find($id) / Product::find($data['id']) without company_id, then save overwrites company_id. ProductUpdateController later lacked MainController auth. Authenticated (and on the update form, unauthenticated) users could read another tenant's price/cost/stock/SKU/barcode and hijack the row.
flaw_origin: First write of the unscoped Product::find sinks in app/Http/Controllers/ProductController.php edit/save in 0a2eeb13e0a020bc59c7622527c49a15087869da (2017 Product basic CRUD). Parent 91c994d5 has that path but only index() and no find. Later extract/move to ProductUpdateController (5f6379ac/9e07ae4c) and ProductRepository (65f6b9f9) are not BIC. Missing MainController on the extracted update controller is a 2022 regression, not the first write of the IDOR lines.
evidence: Advisory GHSA-xrvm-rxhf-gwgp / CVE-2026-19734 (published, withdrawn_at null; not rejected) names ProductUpdateController without MainController and ProductRepository::save Product::find($data['id']) then company_id overwrite. git log -S Product::find -- ProductController.php: 0a2eeb13 adds find, c028795f removes save-find, 5f6379ac removes edit-find. cat-file -p 0a2eeb13: Gustavo Novaro author/committer, message Product basic CRUD, no Co-Authored-By/Generated-with, single parent 91c994d5. cat-file -e parent:app/Http/Controllers/ProductController.php succeeds; parent blob has class ProductController extends MainController and index() only. 0a2eeb13 adds edit() Product::find($id) and save() Product::find($request->id). e0e204da (2021) adds company_id overwrite on that unscoped find (hijack). c028795f scopes list/add but leaves edit find. 5f6379ac extracts empty ProductUpdateController (no extends MainController) and retargets /product/update/{id}; 9e07ae4c fills update() with the same Product::find($id). 65f6b9f9 moves save find into new ProductRepository (parent path absent for that file; still a move of existing sink). BIC and those later commits: author/committer Gustavo Novaro, no AI markers. Fix f36c2a11 adds extends MainController and where('company_id', Auth::user()->company_id)->findOrFail. ppa re-checked line-level 2026-08-29: numactl git show 0a2eeb1^:app/Http/Controllers/ProductController.php contains only index() while BIC 0a2eeb1's diff adds edit() with 'Product::find($id)' and save() with 'Product::find($request->id)' — unauthorized cross-company product read/write lines new at BIC. -> introducer_parent_absent=true.
reasoning: Vulnerability is real: unscoped product lookup plus later tenant overwrite, and missing MainController on the extracted update controller. BIC is the smallest public commit that first wrote Product::find on edit/save; parent has the file without those lines. 5f6379ac/9e07ae4c/65f6b9f9 are split/move/refactor of that sink, not first-write. AI role is judged only from the BIC object: human Gustavo Novaro in 2017, no bot author, no Co-Authored-By/Generated-with. Later AI in this repo on unrelated controllers does not attribute this BIC. Therefore NOT_AI.
